t0364-01.gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
t0364-01.rival_reading: Responders could have collected the violet powder while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

t0364-02.gloss: A crew was told to listen and keep quiet before any closure was public.
t0364-02.rival_reading: A foreman could fix a radio to one channel for ordinary site safety; nothing says who gave the order.
